name: Gap direction set, then a new day extreme
why: The overnight gap is repositioning that tends to continue into the cash session (gap-agree cascade). A fresh high (low) in that direction. Pre-registered 2026-10-17 (research/preregistered/2026-10-17_direction_sources.md).

scan.when: !rollwin && abs(gap) >= 0.1 && ((sign(gap) > 0 && cl(5,1) > lag(5, hi_since(9,30))) || (sign(gap) < 0 && cl(5,1) < lag(5, lo_since(9,30))))
